name: What is the typical cost to build a detached guest suite in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to build a detached guest suite in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a detached guest suite in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on size, finishes, and specific features. Factors like plumbing for a bathroom or kitchen, electrical hookups, HVAC systems, and high-end materials will increase the overall investment. Permitting fees and site preparation are also considerations. A basic unit might start around $70,000, while a larger, more luxurious suite could exceed $150,000.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a detached guest suite in Las Vegas typically range from $70,000 to over $150,000, depending on size, finishes, and amenities.
